# TS-004: Firewall rules that mention tailscale0 have a running tailnet behind them

- **Group:** Tailscale
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

UFW rules on tailscale0 only work while Tailscale is installed, logged in and Running. Without it they are dead rules: they look like a private path in reviews and give none.

## Verify by hand

```sh
sudo ufw status verbose | grep tailscale0; tailscale status
```

## How to fix it

Install and log in Tailscale, or remove the tailscale0 rules and keep a path you actually have

## What a fix can break

Removing the rules is harmless when Tailscale is gone; check you still have another way in first.

Run `stackward explain TS-004` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
